question: Does the unchanged anchor preflight accept synthetic sealed bytes and reject root/dependency drift, symlink aliases and missing files with exact predeclared errors?
decision_rule: Full requires all five cases with exact JSON/exit codes, empty stderr, unchanged source seals and captured pidfd-confirmed cleanup. Smoke runs positive and changed-root only, exactly four inherited CPUs, writes only external smoke result and cannot satisfy full completion. No physical or target qualification.
reservation_rationale: 300s admission reservation; <=180s workload, each child <=5s plus <=4s cleanup, stop immediately on answer/failure; no padding or retries.
stop_on_answer: All selected cases match exact outcomes, then exit immediately.
stop_on_futility: First mismatch, STOP/deadline, source drift or cleanup failure.
